risk_note: RV2 (apps/api/src/modules/payout/**, entry.ts). Production wiring gap 5 (orchestrator 11-02 03:49, moved from withdraw to pay). The payout entry now runs createQueryRecovery (B2-06e, no caller until now): one round once the queue started, then one every hour, in dry_run and live. Without it a PAYING withdrawal whose query job was lost was never queried again nor marked needs_manual (BR-WDR-14). The scan's judgement is unchanged. Rounds never overlap; a failed round is one warn line with the error's name and does not take the process down; stop waits for the round in flight and runs before metrics, queue and context close (D10-553). The runtime stays optional for the entry. No schema, contract or ledger change.
